name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Skanneloppet
price_range: Fram till 7 oktober: 17,3 km 200 kr; 7,6 km 150 kr; 3,9 km 100 kr. 8 oktober – 24 oktober: 17,3 km 300 kr; 7,6 km 200 kr; 3,9 km 150 kr. 25 oktober – 5 november: 17,3 km 400 kr; 7,6 km 300 kr; 3,9 km 250 kr.
description: Skanneloppet is organized by IS Skanne and takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, starting and finishing at Tingvalla amusement palace in Åstorp. The race is run individually, with approximately ten runners starting per minute, and offers three courses for both elite runners and recreational runners. The courses are hilly and run mostly on gravel roads, with some asphalt and trails, and the race is suitable for both young and old. Registration information and start lists are published on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Three distances: Red 17.3 km, Blue 7.6 km, and Green 3.9 km
Hilly terrain—mostly gravel roads with some asphalt and trails; particularly hilly at the beginning
Aid stations are marked on the map (yellow circles)
additional: Bib pickup from 08:00 on race day. Check your bib number in the start list inside Tingvalla and collect it yourself. No on-site registration. There are no showers or changing rooms on site (toilets are available). Medical assistance is available at the finish, and a defibrillator is available. Maximum running time is until approximately 12:30. Those who register before October 24 will have their name printed on their bib. All finishers receive a commemorative plaque; commemorative medals are awarded after completing 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 races. Start times are between 10:00 and 11:05, with approximately 10 runners starting per minute. Start and finish: Tingvalla, Vramsvägen 9, Åstorp. No on-site registration. Showers and changing facilities are unavailable; toilets are available. Start lists and results are published on the IS Skanne website. Bibs for the 17.3 km race can be collected on site from 08:00 on race day.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Craft Idre Fjällmaraton
description:
Become unbeatable
We believe everyone has the right to feel unbeatable at some point. Not in relation to anyone else, but in relation to yourself. Unbeatable because you achieved something you didn’t think was possible. Because you dared to do something you didn’t think you could. Because you ventured into unknown territory and won. You won over that little voice telling you that you can’t.

description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun is an evening race at Kroppefjäll B&B in Dals Rostock, offering runners three main distance options (42 km, 21 km and 10.5 km) in two-person teams, as well as a children’s race around the pond. The course is technical terrain with plenty of singletrack and natural trails, and the race has a relaxed, adventurous atmosphere with no official timing. After the finish, participants can use the large sauna and take a refreshing dip in the pond. Accommodation can also be booked at Kroppefjäll B&B with discounts. The organisers welcome both experienced trail runners and younger participants (Lilla KTR) in a friendly setting.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Järnleden and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race takes place on varied and characterful terrain—deep forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and old trails—putting both mental toughness and the joy of running to the test. The start and finish are at Hultets friluftsgård, and the 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden. The organiser, Topp & Dröm, welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Järnleden through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and old trails)
Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn

additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård; from 1 October, places are limited to ensure a specially designed medal for every participant; organiser: Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / telephone 073-853 75 21), and the information pages have sections on aid stations and equipment. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No cups are provided at the aid stations; bring your own cup. Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn. Entry fees are updated over time, and from 1 October, places are limited to secure a specially designed medal for every participant.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was founded in 2015 and can be described as a recreational race where nature, camaraderie and the experience take centre stage, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers all runners, regardless of ability, a fantastic opportunity to take part in one of three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail) and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has 500 metres of elevation gain.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to enjoy running on Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in the Billingen Recreation Area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 metres of elevation gain. It goes all the way around northern Billingen, along beautiful trails by the edge of the mountain. As a runner, you’ll experience varied terrain, including deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows and spruce forest, as well as beautiful views across the landscape from several places. The surface varies from easy-to-run sections and approximately 6 km of asphalt to some more challenging parts.

The middle-distance course, 21 km, follows the northern section of the Billinge Trail and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain. The course includes a mix of trails, meadows and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, has just over 200 metres of elevation gain and follows trails of varying difficulty, with some short sections on roads.

Information about the courses and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, 10:00, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.
21 km, 10:45, Björnasäter, Lerdala. Bus departs from the Billingen Recreation Area at 10:05.
12 km, 11:30, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

All finishers cross the finish line at the stadium.

description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km loop with 400 m of elevation gain. After five loops, you’ll have covered the ultra distance of 50 km and 2,000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail running on singletrack and animal trails through dramatic forest! Welcome!
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories
Isaberg Gravel: a circuit of approximately 45 km, starting and finishing in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to age 50: 3 laps, older riders/sport recreation: 2 laps, recreational: 1 lap
additional: Contact GI by mobile at +46 703 815 118 or email at gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Guided rides for cycling groups can be booked; the organisers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group’s needs. Main distance: approximately 10.5 km (Distans Trailtour); Kids Trail: approximately 2 km with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain; start time: Sunday at 12:00; location: Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact: niklas@isabergtrail.se.

description: Dammekärr Dirt Dash is a trail-running series in Dammekärr organised by the orienteering club OK Alehof. The competition consists of three races with combined scoring, and participants can choose to run one, two or all three races. The courses run through hilly forest terrain and come in three different distances: 1.5 km, 3.5 km and 7.0 km. The short course follows the floodlit trail, while the longer courses require a headlamp. After the finish, runners can enjoy a hot sauna and refreshments in the club cabin, creating a pleasant and social atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hilly forest terrain around Dammekärr
Short course (1.5 km) on the floodlit trail
Longer courses (3.5 km and 7.0 km) require a headlamp
additional: The competition takes place in the evening. Participation is free for OK Alehof members. Timing is done using a SportIdent card, which can be borrowed on site. After the race, a hot sauna and refreshments are available in the club cabin. The series features results, live updates and an archive of previous races.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organising an evening race for the 53rd time during Hörby Market, with three different distances:

Marknadsloppet 12.6 km: the competitive class starts at 18:30, and the recreational class starts at 18:40.

Bil-Månsson loppet 6.1 km: everyone starts at 18:50.

CAN-CAN loppet 3.4 km: everyone starts at 19:00.

The race starts and finishes in central Hörby, with much of the route running through woodland.
Varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and trails. See maps.

Don't miss this opportunity!
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu — right up until the race starts.

Late registration is available at the entrance to Lågehallarna (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners is available at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Signposting from National Road 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information about preparations, registration, the course and directions is available at the link:
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

name: Mariestads Marathon
description: The race follows the shore of Lake Vänern along a cycle path. It is a lap race: the 7 km distance is one lap, 21.1 km is three laps, and 42.2 km is six laps.
additional: Information will be available on the website.

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is the most generous race of the year, where the joy of running meets the beautiful scenery of Djurgården. The course winds along gravel and asphalt roads, offering a wonderful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 people to register will receive a specially designed T-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, a relaxing After Run awaits with a barbecue and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. A portion of the registration fee also goes to Sweden for UNHCR, so every step counts—for you and for someone in need.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Experience Borås at its best—run Kretsloppet! On September 19, we’ll once again fill the streets of Borås with runners of all ages for a running festival you have to experience. Sign up with family, friends and colleagues, and cross the finish line to the cheers of the crowd in the heart of Borås city centre. All courses are on asphalt, relatively flat and in central Borås. A warm welcome to the running festival!

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!

The course has an elevation gain of just 74 m, with the start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken, where there will be something for the whole family to do.

name: Mattila Trail Run
description: On Saturday, September 26, 2026, the Mattila Trail Run will take place, following its successful debut in 2025. The race runs through the beautiful Finnskogen forest in Värmland, across marshes, over boardwalks, and through a mix of old-growth and managed forest. Some sections take you past cultural sites, as much of the route passes through the historic cultural heritage of Finnskogen. Enjoy a memorable trail-running experience with plenty of challenging climbs and, in some places, technical trails. Welcome to a true adventure!

name: Springtime
description:
Since its launch in 1981, Helsingborg Stadslopp has attracted runners from near and far.

The race runs through the central parts of the city, with the start and finish at Stortorget. Distances are 5 km and 10 km.

MiniSpringtime is a 1 km race for children born in 2016–2020. Alla Kan Springa is a race for people with disabilities (all ages) and follows the same course as MiniSpringtime.

The course follows flat, fast-running cycle paths and roads, with only about 70 metres of total elevation gain. Many runners have set half-marathon personal bests at this race, which has been officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association for records and statistics.

description:

Can your running training last all year round? Each season brings its own trail race, shaped by its conditions. In the spring race, we enjoy a brighter spring evening. Without headlamps or reflectors, we can now run along dry trails and take in the beautiful scenery and views over lakes and tarns.

description: 12-hour backyard on a lovely loop, starting and finishing at the MSOK cabin in Mullsjö.

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet 2026 is a peace and solidarity race held at several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm, between 15 August and 18 October 2026. The event is more than a running race; it is an expression of peace, justice and solidarity, supporting Palestinian and Cuban organisations. Participants can choose from different distances, including 5 km and 10 km, as well as walking categories and mini peace races for children. The event encourages people to organise their own Fredsloppet races, and the surplus goes to peace and solidarity work.
course_highlights: Several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm
Distances for all ages and levels, including children’s and family races
Focus on peace, solidarity and justice, supporting Palestinian organisations
additional: 75% of the proceeds go to Palestinian aid, and the event celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. Participants can register via fredsloppet.se. The event includes water stations, medals and the option to register on the day.

name: Stora Sköndalsvarvet
description: A beautiful 5-kilometre course (5,100 metres) on roads and trails, starting at Stora Sköndal, passing through the Orhem allotment area and Flatens Nature Reserve. Hilly in places.
additional: Bag drop and race bib collection from 16:30; warm-up at 17:15. No start waves.

name: Häljebodaloppet
description: You run or walk 7.3 km through beautiful scenery on gravel roads and along a section of the Finnskogleden trail. The race has received a lot of praise for its scenic course.
additional: Prizes will be awarded, including a perpetual trophy from Magnor Glassworks (one for the men and one for the women), as well as first, second and third prizes in each class. A “mountain prize” will also go to the first woman and the first man to reach the course’s highest point. Those who prefer to take it a little easier won’t go home empty-handed either. All participants receive a certificate, and there will be a draw based on race numbers.

description:
Bohuslän’s Saltiest, 18/7 on Hamburgö – a nature-filled family event with the sea, cliffs and magical views. For all levels: two children’s races (250 m & 950 m), 6.5 km, 13 km and 11 km trail.

An alcohol-free and nicotine-free event where community, health and joy are at the heart of it.

25% of the entry fee goes to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund.

Experience the finest day of summer by the sea!

name: Hiit Out - Trailrun 2026
description:
Welcome to HIIT OUT – Trailrun – a trail race with challenging running and a wonderful experience in nature!

Choose from four distances: 4 km, 8 km, 12 km or 16 km.

The course takes you through varied terrain, with trails, plenty of elevation gain and sections where you can expect your shoes to get a little wet. It’s not just about the kilometres—the terrain will bring both challenges and running joy along the way.

Four distances. Plenty of trails. Lots of elevation gain. Slightly wet shoes. Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part!

Choose your distance and Hiit Out!

Together with the spectators, sponsors and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable stadium experience.

Mustaschmilen in Gothenburg has three distances: 5 km, 10 km and a 1 km children’s race. The two longer races will be run on a loop course, with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-metre course.

Gather your friends, colleagues and teammates, and come to Olstorp. There are races for everyone, big and small.

name: VAIS-loppet
description:
The VAIS race is organised by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn.

The race follows a hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd Nature Reserve, and you can choose between two distances: 4.4 kilometres and 8.4 kilometres.

Both courses start together at 18:30 by the VAIS cabin. After the races, we round things off with coffee and refreshments.
additional: The race is free for members of Växjö AIS. For non-members, the entry fee is 50 kronor.

name: Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia
description:
Only the 100-mile race starts on Friday (08:00); the 100 km and 50-mile races start on Saturday (06:00).
All three races have their own routes (they have nothing in common with CBMR, which takes place on the same day). The 50-mile and 100-mile races have some staffed aid stations, which are also shared with the 100 km race, which has its own stations as well. The 100-mile race is virtually entirely unsupported, apart from a few unmanned water stations. You also pass a well-stocked country store and a church with water and toilets.
All three races offer the option of a drop bag.
The courses are completely unmarked, so you navigate using a downloaded GPX file...
additional:
We don’t have paper cups, so bring a cup!
Hot food, drinks, coffee and cake are served after the finish.

The entry fee includes 120:-, which is sent to a children’s race in Urique, Mexico!

name: Caballo Blanco Memorial Run (CBMR)
description:
This is the route that Caballo Blanco (aka Micah True) and I ran on 2011-09-26, when he was visiting Sweden at my invitation. In spring 2012, we received the news that he had died. We then organised a memorial race on 2012-09-22. It became a tradition, and eventually the race offered 1, 2 or 4 laps of the route, which is approximately 11 km and has approximately 150 metres of elevation gain.
See also Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia — an ultra race held at the same time.
An article I wrote quite a while ago, when we introduced the 50-mile race:
https://redsports.se/CBM/TheStory.html
additional:
The 4-lap race starts at 12:00, while the 1- and 2-lap races start at 15:00.
Please note that you must bring your own cup/mug.
The entry fee includes drinks, energy products, and a hot meal with coffee and cake after the race.

name: Bräkneåns Dalgång 25 K
description:
A technical trail race through the Bräkneån valley, starting at Hoby Ekebacke. The course is partly technical but also includes sections of asphalt.
The course has a total elevation gain of approximately 400 metres.
The generous time limit is 5 hours, allowing a maximum average pace of 12 min/km.
The finish is at Hoby Eckebacke.

The course will be clearly marked, and a GPX file will also be available for you to download to your watch or phone.
An aid station with food and drink will be available halfway, as well as at the start and finish.

Everyone who completes the race within the time limit will receive a lovely medal from RawCut studio.
additional:
Start and finish at Ekebacken Bräkne-hoby

Women’s/men’s category

name: Hoby Backyard Ultra 24 H
description:
Hoby Backyard Ultra 24H. Start and finish at Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby on Saturday, 26/9 at 10:00.
The course is the same as before, with varied terrain and approximately 60 metres of elevation gain.
The course has been officially measured using a measuring wheel and is 6,706 metres long.
Each lap starts on the hour. To complete the lap and continue to the next one, each lap must be completed within 1 hour.

Energy, drinks, sports drinks, and hot meals will be served to all participants throughout the race.

Everyone who completes at least 1 lap within the time limit will receive a stylish medal from RawCut Studio.

All participants can take shelter under the roof inside Rotundan at Ekebacken throughout the race.

Medically trained race staff will be on site throughout the race.

Welcome to another fantastic running festival!
additional:
Start and finish at Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby.

Women’s and men’s categories.

name: Vildmarksleden 100 miles
description:
The first edition of Vildmarksleden 100 Miles, with an exclusive limit of just 25 places.

An out-and-back trail race taking you from Hoby Ekebacke to Eringsboda and then back to Hoby Ekebacke.

The course follows selected sections of Vildmarksleden and includes technical trails, gravel roads and asphalt. Approximately 1,850 metres of elevation gain.

One drop box, transported by the organizer to the turnaround point (50 miles) in Eringsboda. Opportunities to refill fluids and energy supplies at several points along the course.

A GPX file on a watch or mobile phone is mandatory.

Participation is entirely at your own risk. Participants are responsible for having the knowledge and equipment required to complete the race.
additional:
Start and finish at Ekebacken, Bräkne-Hoby
Men’s and women’s categories

name: GUM - Gotland Ultramarathon
description:
One of Sweden’s most beautiful ultramarathons. The race starts at 9:00 at Hallshuk in northern Gotland, and the course heads south along the coast, with the sea on your right all the way to Visby. The route is approximately 50 km, with very varied terrain.

There is also a Half-GUM (28 km), starting at 11:00 in Lickershamn.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km loop through varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class. The 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat, fast course through the heart of the city and along the beautiful shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is a loop course, with 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organised race for all levels.

The race is for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and generous time limits will be set for completing the race.

A warm welcome!

name: Kilterrängen
description: Are you among those who prefer trails to asphalt? Whether you’re a curious beginner, a recreational runner, or an elite runner, Kilterrängen is for you. Starting and finishing at Frykstahöjden in Kil, this 16 km trail race ends with a few tough kilometres full of hills, including the notorious ski slope. The course is just as suitable for running at full speed as for jogging, walking with poles, or hiking. You can also choose to run 6 km, with the same tough finish as the longer course.

name: Löparfesten
description:
The running festival offers several different races, with something for everyone!

Whether you’re looking to set a personal best in the half marathon or prefer a walk with good friends, there’s a great race to choose from!

EKO ½Maran is for experienced runners, FORMTOPPEN Milen is a wonderful challenge, and the slightly shorter Here We Go 5an is for happy recreational runners or those who prefer to run fast but short. For those who want to take it a little easier, perhaps bring walking poles or a stroller, or simply enjoy nature, there’s Here We Go 5an – Promenad!

There are also races for younger participants—Papricaloppet—for everyone up to 12 years old! We also have Rulleruset for everyone with a disability! At Rulleruset, you can choose between a shorter 1.4 km race and a slightly longer 5 km race!

As we said, there’s something for everyone!

name: Å-stadsloppet
description:
Å-stadsloppet runs through both Örebro’s neighborhoods and scenic areas such as Rynningeviken and Wadköping.

The 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses have all been officially measured by federation course measurer Bertil Sundin.

description:
UPPSALA MARATHON
17 OCTOBER 2026

MARATHON • HALF MARATHON • MARATHON RELAY

description: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail adventure for those who love experiences, running and beautiful nature. Choose to run 42 km, 21 km or 10 km, and the children can also take part in Barnens Fjällmaraton. Along mountain trails, paths, boardwalks and gravel roads, nature will challenge you on your way to the finish and the After Run at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a long-established fun run in the heart of Ängelholm. Participants experience the town, the sea and the forest all in the same 10 kilometres. The 5 km race begins with a lovely run through the park in the charming Hembygdsparken. After approximately 2.7 km, the course crosses the Rönne River and continues along the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen. Finally, the course turns back across the river, with a sprint to the finish at Tullakrok. The 10 km course starts the same way as the 5 km route, but turns north after about a kilometre. Runners are treated to beautiful views over Skälderviken and its harbour, with Kullaberg visible in the background. After approximately 7.7 km, the courses join again, and runners can enjoy the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen.
additional:
The deadline for standard registration is 18 May, but late registration is available until one hour before the start of each race.

description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a runnable road race, set in landscapes that feel like true mountain running. The roads are quiet, often with more reindeer than cars, and the surroundings offer an almost otherworldly stillness. It’s a journey through both nature and history, where every step is buoyed by the vast mountains, crisp air and silence.
